contracts.title: Shelf-Stable Rations Program
contracts.flavor: Preservation fields for emergency food stocks. Unfashionable, well-paid.

contracts.title: Grid-Scale Field Capacitors
contracts.flavor: A utility consortium wants your sensor notes for load-balancing hardware.

contracts.title: Orbital Survey Array
contracts.flavor: Government survey work: adapt your gravity readings for orbital sensors.

contracts.title: Portable Containment Units
contracts.flavor: A freight giant will pay for stabilizer know-how it can bolt onto trucks.

contracts.title: Directed-Energy Testbed
contracts.flavor: Military money. Dangerous-adjacent work, no questions asked, many paid.

contracts.title: Trade Route Beacons
contracts.flavor: Only offered once the trade routes open. Beacons keyed to your gravity data.

contracts.title: Harmonic Furnace Linings
contracts.flavor: Industrial acoustics: line their furnaces with your resonance notes.

contracts.title: Pressure-Hardened Sensors
contracts.flavor: Deep-ocean work needs probes that survive the trench. Your deep-field notes apply.

contracts.title: Cold-Storage Vaults
contracts.flavor: Preserve paper for centuries. Unfashionable, steady, honest work.

contracts.title: Quarantine Cold Chain
contracts.flavor: Military cold-chain logistics. Pays like the army, watches like the army.

contracts.title: Signal Relay Harmonics
contracts.flavor: Only offered after the deep signal arrives. Tune relays to an alien carrier.

contracts.title: Bloom-Season Vaults
contracts.flavor: Offered during bloom season. Entropic-cycle storage for the world's seeds.

contracts.title: Black-Site Hardening
contracts.flavor: Offered only after war breaks out. Harden a site you will never be allowed to visit.

contracts.title: Sentinel Early Warning
contracts.flavor: Only for trusted contractors. Gravity-sensor pickets that watch the rivals watching you.
